quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen press release: AMGEN'S REPATHA REDUCES RISK OF DEATH IN PATIENTS AT HIGH (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: A pre-specified analysis of the Phase 3 VESALIUS-CV trial presented at ESC Congress 2026 (published in Circulation) showed Repatha (evolocumab) reduced the risk of death from all causes by 20% in more than 12,000 high-risk patients without a prior heart attack or stroke, with reductions in both overall and cardiovascular deaths appearing after approximately 1.5 years and continuing through a median follow-up of 4.6 years; Amgen calls Repatha the first and only PCSK9 inhibitor shown to lower all-cause mortality in high-risk primary prevention in a Phase 3 trial. Further analyses showed reductions in first, subsequent and total CV events and in heart attack risk as early as six months. R&D head Jay Bradner called the totality of the data practice-changing.
quarterly_data.figure: 20% reduction in risk of death; more than 12,000 patients; median follow-up 4.6 years
